Blue Origin is developing reusable space vehicles and systems, including TeraWave, a space-based communications network. The Software Engineer will contribute to the control and data plane architecture of the constellation by developing and maintaining embedded software for constrained, real-time environments, while collaborating with cross-functional teams to optimize system quality and performance.
Aerospace
Manufacturing

No H1B
Responsibilities
Design and develop multi-threaded embedded software in C/C++
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate software with hardware systems
Contribute to technical documentation, code reviews, and design discussions
Troubleshoot problems and debug issues using telemetry, logs/traces, code instrumentation, and software and hardware debugging tools
Develop unit and integration tests and automation for applications and integrate with CI/CD pipelines
Learn fast for mentors and peers, deliver with speed and quality

Required
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field
* 1+ year of experience in embedded software development in C/C++ to run on any of these platforms Linux/RTOS/Bare-metal
* Strong grasp of C++ object-oriented design and implementation concepts
* Knowledge of embedded systems debugging using SW and HW tools (gdb, JTAG, etc.)
* Knowledge of standard peripheral interfaces – SPI, I3C, I2C, PCIe, CAN etc
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum
Preferred
* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field
* 2+ years of experience in embedded software development for mission-critical systems
* Experience with Linux networking and inter-core/processor communications between applications
